title: If Your House Smells Like Fish, Call an Electrician Immediately
description:
You walk into your living room and it smells like fried fish — but nobody's cooking. That smell might be the most expensive one you ever ignore, because somewhere behind your walls, plastic could be melting. Here are 7 warning signs your house sends before disaster strikes, and exactly what to do about each one.

⏱️ CHAPTERS
0:00 The fish smell mystery
0:25 #7 A rumbling water heater
0:58 #6 Bubbling paint on the ceiling
1:29 #5 A breaker that keeps tripping
1:59 #4 Stair-step cracks in the walls
2:31 #3 A yellow pilot light
3:05 #2 That fried fish smell
3:39 #1 The smell of rotten eggs
4:11 The 10-minute weekend check

Which of these have you spotted in your own home? Tell me in the comments.

🔔 Subscribe: one new warning-signs video every week.

DISCLAIMER: General information only. For gas leaks, electrical faults, or structural damage, always call your utility company or a licensed professional.
